# Aurum

> The AI-powered pulse of your money.

Aurum is a multilingual personal finance landing page for a web application that helps users track accounts, transactions, budgets, charts, Telegram notifications and optional AI-assisted financial questions.

## Canonical Pages

- Italian: /
- English: /en/
- German: /de/
- French: /fr/
- Italian privacy: /privacy/
- English privacy: /en/privacy/
- German privacy: /de/privacy/
- French privacy: /fr/privacy/

## Key Topics

- Personal finance tracking
- Budget planning
- Transaction categorization
- AI financial assistant
- Telegram bot
- Encryption at rest
- Bring-your-own AI key
- Aurum-managed AI key

## Public Pricing

- Standard: 1.99 EUR/month or 14.99 EUR/year
- Free: 2.99 EUR/month or 23.99 EUR/year, includes AI with the user's own API key
- Full: 4.99 EUR/month or 39.99 EUR/year, includes AI with Aurum's API key

## Content Source

Localized page copy is stored in Markdown files under `content/<locale>/home.md`.
